content.text: "Ãi he asoli ãngur gas, edde ãr Baf bagan šaši.
Ãr fotti ḍeila zinot gula no dorer, hinore hibaye haṛi fele, ar fotti ḍeila zinot gula dorer, hinore hibaye šaṛiyore foriškar gore, zene aro beši gula dore.
Ãi tũwarare ze kalam hoilam hinor zoriya tũwara beggune age foriškar oiyo.
Ãr butore tako, toi ãi o tũwarar butore taki; zendilla ḍeilaye nize gula dorai no fare, zodi ãngur gas loi laigga no take, hendilla tũwara o ãr butore no takile gula dorai no fariba.
"Ãi ãngur gas; tũwara ḍeila okkol; hite ze ãr butore, ãi hitar butore taki, ar hite beši gula doraibo; kiyollahoile ãre sara tũwara kissu gori no faro.
Hite ze ãr butore no take, hitare ḍeila felaidefan baire felaidiya oibo edde fuwai zaiboi, ar hinore dola gori oinot felaidiya o edde hinore furifela o.
Zodi tũwara ãr butore tako, ar ãr kalam tũwarar butore take, tũwara za issa mago, hin tũwaralla gora oibo.
Iyanot ãr Baf mohimawala o, ze tũwara beši fól dorao, edde tũwara ãr sahabi forman oiba.
"Bafe zendilla ãre ador goijje, ãi o tũwarare ador goijji; tũwara ãr adorot tako.
Tũwara zodi ãr hokum okkol falon goro, toile tũwara o ãr adorot takiba, zendilla ãi o ãr Bafor hár hokum okkol falon goriyore hibar adoror butore taikki.
In okkol ãi tũwarare hoilam, zene tũwarar dilot ãr anondo take edde tũwarar anondo furafuri furon o.
Ãr hokum oilde ei: Tũwara ekzone oinnozonore ador goro, zendilla ãi tũwarare ador goijji.
Hono ekzone hitar bondu okkololla nizor zibon de, hiyanottuwaro mohan ador kissu nai.
Tũwarare ãi ze hokum okkol dir, hin zodi falon goro, toile tũwara ãr bondu okkol.
Ãi tũwarare ar gulam no ḍakir, kiyollahoile malike ki gore, gulame hiyan no zane, ar ãi tũwarare bondu ḍaikki, kiyollahoile hár kissu zin ãr Bafor hãsottu fuinni, hin tũwarare zanaiyi.
Tũwara ãre basi no lo, kintu ãi tũwarare basi loiyi, ar buwayi zene tũwara zo edde gula dorao, gula zene ṭiki take, toi zene tũwara ãr name Bafor hãse za kissu saiba, hin hibaye tũwarare de.
Ei oilde ãr hokum tũwaralla: Ekzonore ekzone ador goro.
"Duniyaiye zodi tũwarare hingša gore, tũwara to zano, hiyane tũwarar age ãre hingša goijje.
Tũwara zodi duniyair oita, toile duniyaiye tũwarare nizor hoi ador goitto; kintu tũwara zehon duniyair no, bolke ãi tũwarare duniyaittu basi loiyi, etolla duniyaiye tũwarare hingša gore.

Ãr ei hota tũwara monot raikko: Ekzon gulam hitar malikottuwaro ḍõr no: hitara zodi ãre zulum goijje, toile tũwarare o hitara zulum goribo; ar hitara zodi ãr kalam falon gorito, hitara tũwarargun o funito.
Kintu hitara ãr namolla boli tũwarare in okkol goribo, kiyollahoile ãre ze defeṛaiye, hibare hitara no zane.
Ãi zodi nu aitam edde hitarar hãse no hoitam, toile hitara hosuri sara oito; kintu ehon hitarar gunar kofiyot dibolla hono rasta nai.
Hite ze ãre hingša gore, hite ãr Bafore o hingša gore.
Ãi zodi hendilla ham okkol gori no dehaitam, zin oinno honokiye no gore, toile hitarattu guna no oito; kintu ehon hitara ãr ham okkol deikke, ar ãre edde ãr Bafore hingša gorer.
Kintu endilla oiye, zene hitarar ainot ziyan leka ase hiyan furon o: 'Hitara hono kissu sara ãre hingša goijje.'
"Modot goroya zẽtte aibo, zare ãi Bafor hentu tũwarar hãse defeṛaiyum, soiyir he Ruh, ze Bafor hentu niyoli zar, hibaye ãr babute goba dibo.
Ar tũwara o ãr goba, kiyollahoile tũwara šuruttu loti ãr fũwati aso.
